label: Icelandic occupational pension
name: Fund name
quoteHelp: Use the fund’s estimate for the chosen payment start in today’s ISK. Update the amount if the fund’s quote changes.
startHelp: The first payment follows the fund’s monthly calendar and falls within its confirmed age range.
ageHelp: Use the ages confirmed by your fund. Enter the same age twice when it has a fixed start age.
timingHelp: With a first-day payment, an age-based start begins the month after the birthday. With a last-day payment, it begins in the birthday month.
invalidOwner: Choose a person for the pension.
invalidBirth: Enter the pension recipient’s birth year and month in the profile.
invalidAgeRange: The latest claim age must be at least the earliest claim age.
invalidStart: Choose a valid age, date or milestone. An event without a known date requires a non-negative offset.
